proposed_rules.trigger: A grid/row of filter chip options (e.g. Industry, Business Need, Work O...) with a 'Clear All' control, directly above a repeating card grid on listing/category pages (blog, ebook-category, use-case-2).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a distinct 'filter-bar' block (facets), separate from the card-grid block it filters, rather than folding it into the card-grid block or treating it as page chrome.
proposed_rules.rationale: It is interactive listing content, not decoration or global chrome; rejected alternatives: (a) merging into the card-grid block (violates minimize-block-cells by conflating two different repeating structures), (b) treating as noise (it is authorable facet content).

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width bg:gradient/bg:color zone directly above the footer with no captured text or child nodes.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction rather than treating as a pure decorative section background.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same empty zone recurs on use-case pages (C259, C39) and here on a listing template, suggesting a site-wide newsletter/CTA component that the capture never renders.

provenance.evidence: C41 rc1c2c2 [bg:gradient] 1280x507 with no child text

proposed_rules.trigger: Identical top nav and bottom footer recur on every captured page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global header/footer fragments, excluded from the per-page section/block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across all templates; not covered by existing noise rules.

notes: Listing/category page (blog-post-4 dominant, also ebook-category and use-case-2): filter chip facets, then a 3x3 post card grid with Load More, then the recurring empty pre-footer band.
